title: Fatal error: Uncaught UnexpectedValueException: Could not find declaring method for ...
body:
I'm using the default configuration generated by `psalm --init`.

My best guess is this is due to use of `__call` method to dynamically handle undefined methods. They are never declared explicitly.

https://secure.php.net/manual/en/language.oop5.overloading.php#object.call

It looks like psalms can't handle this and fails with an `UnexpectedValueException`. Full output below.

```
$ ./vendor/bin/psalm
Scanning files...
Analyzing files...
PHP Fatal error:  Uncaught UnexpectedValueException: Could not find declaring method for myclass::mymethod in /home/jdufresne/myproject/vendor/vimeo/psalm/src/Psalm/Internal/Analyzer/Statements/Expression/CallAnalyzer.php:142
Stack trace:
#0 /home/jdufresne/myproject/vendor/vimeo/psalm/src/Psalm/Internal/Analyzer/Statements/Expression/Call/MethodCallAnalyzer.php(829): Psalm\Internal\Analyzer\Statements\Expression\CallAnalyzer::collectSpecialInformation(Object(Psalm\Internal\Analyzer\MethodAnalyzer), 'mymethod', Object(Psalm\Context))
#1 /home/jdufresne/myproject/vendor/vimeo/psalm/src/Psalm/Internal/Analyzer/Statements/Expression/Call/MethodCallAnalyzer.php(199): Psalm\Internal\Analyzer\Statements\Expression\Call\MethodCallAnalyzer::analyzeAtomicCall(Object(Psalm\Internal\Analyzer\StatementsAnalyzer), Object(PhpParser\Node\Expr\MethodCall), Object(Psalm\Codebase), Object(Psalm\Context), Object(Psalm\Type\Atomic\TNamedObject), '$this', NULL, false, false, true, false, Array, Array, Array, Arr in /home/jdufresne/myproject/vendor/vimeo/psalm/src/Psalm/Internal/Analyzer/Statements/Expression/CallAnalyzer.php on line 142
```
